# salucallc/.github

> Organization-wide community health defaults for salucallc GitHub repos: security policy, contributing guide, code of conduct, issue and pull request templates, and the organization profile. MIT licence.

GitHub shows these files in any salucallc repo that has no file of the same type; a repo's own file always wins. They do not apply to saluca-labs repos. There is no code, no CODEOWNERS and no workflows here; reusable CI lives in salucallc/ci-shared.

If a file is not listed here, this repo does not provide it, and GitHub falls back to nothing. The complete surface is the six files below plus the organization profile.

The full text of this repository's prose docs, concatenated, each under its path. Regenerate this file whenever one of them changes.

## README.md

### salucallc/.github

Organization-wide community health defaults for [salucallc](https://github.com/salucallc) repositories.

GitHub automatically applies the contents of this repository as default templates for any salucallc repo that does not override them locally. Repo-local files always win.

#### Status

Maintained. Today it provides the files listed under Usage. It covers the `salucallc` organization only: GitHub applies an org's `.github` repo to that org's repos, so `saluca-labs` repos do not inherit these files.

##### Corrections, 2026-10-22

This README described several things this repo does not contain or do:

- It listed issue templates for "bug report, feature request, security (pointer), config gating contact links". Only the bug report and feature request templates exist; there is no security template and no `config.yml`.
- It said `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` is the Contributor Covenant 2.1. It is a shorter code of conduct written for Saluca, not the Contributor Covenant.
- It listed a `CODEOWNERS` file with a default owner. There is no `CODEOWNERS` file here, and GitHub does not apply `CODEOWNERS` from an org's `.github` repo to other repos.
- It listed default workflows in `.github/workflows/`. There is no workflows directory. GitHub does not run workflows from this repo in other repos; reusable workflows live in [`salucallc/ci-shared`](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared).
- Under Maintenance it said direct pushes to `main` are disabled and that Dependabot bumps action pins weekly. On 2026-10-22 `main` had no branch protection or ruleset, and there is no Dependabot configuration in this repo (it has no workflows to bump).

#### Install

Nothing to install. GitHub reads these files from this repository; consuming repos do nothing.

#### Quickstart

Open the security policy of a salucallc repo that has no `SECURITY.md` of its own, for example
<https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared/security/policy>. GitHub shows this repo's [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
there, with the `security@saluca.com` reporting address.

#### Usage

What this repo provides:

| File | Used by GitHub as |
|---|---|
| [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) | the security policy (reporting address `security@saluca.com`) |
| [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) | the contributing guidelines |
| [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | the code of conduct (reports to `conduct@saluca.com`) |
| [`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md`](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md) | the "Bug report" issue template |
| [`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md`](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md) | the "Feature request" issue template |
| [`.github/pull_request_template.md`](.github/pull_request_template.md) | the pull request template |
| [`profile/README.md`](profile/README.md) | the text on the [salucallc organization page](https://github.com/salucallc) |

A repo overrides any of these by adding its own file of the same name. For CI, a repo adds a thin workflow at `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that calls the reusable workflows in [`salucallc/ci-shared`](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared); see its README for the call surface and pinning guidance.

#### Architecture

There is no code. GitHub looks for each community health file in the repo itself first, then in this repo (at the root or in `.github/`). This repo must stay public for that to work. `LICENSE` and `README.md` here describe this repo only and are not inherited.

#### Maintenance

- Changes land via PR to `main`.
- A change here changes every salucallc repo that does not override the file, so keep the files general and free of internal details.

#### Citation

No archived record yet.

#### License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). Templates are intentionally liberal so forks and external contributors can reuse them.

#### Links

- [salucallc/ci-shared](https://github.com/salucallc/ci-shared): reusable GitHub Actions workflows
- [GitHub docs: default community health files](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/setting-up-your-project-for-healthy-contributions/creating-a-default-community-health-file)

_Last updated: 2026-10-22_

## SECURITY.md

### Security Policy

#### Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in any Saluca LLC product, **do not open a public issue**. Email **security@saluca.com** with:

- Affected product and version
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact assessment
- Your name and contact info for follow-up (if you want credit)

We aim to acknowledge reports within **2 business days** and produce a fix or mitigation timeline within **10 business days** for confirmed issues.

#### Scope

In scope for coordinated disclosure:
- Anything published under the `salucallc` or `saluca-labs` GitHub organizations.
- Any Saluca-hosted service: `*.saluca.com`, `*.tiresias.network`, `*.asphodel.ai`.

Out of scope:
- Rate-limiting issues on public endpoints (report as a regular issue).
- Vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies that have not been verified as exploitable in our deployment.

#### Safe-harbor

Security researchers acting in good faith under this policy will not be subject to legal action from Saluca LLC for the research described above.

## CONTRIBUTING.md

### Contributing to Saluca LLC projects

Most Saluca products are dual-licensed: a Noncommercial / research tier under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, and a commercial SKU. Contributions to any Saluca repo are accepted under the same licensing terms as the repo itself.

> Correction, 2026-10-22: the first sentence above does not match the public repos. Of the public repos in the `salucallc` and `saluca-labs` organizations checked on 2026-10-22, none carries a PolyForm licence: the product repos checked (tiresias-core, tartarus-mcp, elysium, hephaestus) use the Functional Source License 1.1 with an Apache 2.0 future licence, and the research repos mostly use Apache-2.0 or MIT. Each repo's `LICENSE` file is the authority.

#### Before you open a PR

1. Check the repo's `README.md` for project-specific contribution notes.
2. Open an issue first for anything larger than a bug fix or a typo... a short design alignment is cheaper than a big PR that gets redirected.
3. Sign commits if the repo requires it (most product repos do; see the repo settings).

#### Scope discipline

- One change per PR. Separate refactors, fixes, and features.
- No backwards-compatibility shims unless specifically asked.
- No speculative abstractions. Three similar lines beats a premature framework.
- Add tests for behavior changes.

#### Style

- Match the surrounding code. Run any linter or formatter the repo ships.
- Commit messages concrete: what changed and why.

#### License + CLA

By submitting a contribution, you agree that the work may be licensed under the repo's declared license, and that you have the rights to license it that way. No separate CLA is required for most repos; some product repos may require one and will surface that on the PR.

#### Security

See `SECURITY.md`. Do not open public issues for security findings.

## CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

### Code of Conduct

All participants in Saluca LLC projects, contributors, maintainers, issue reporters and commenters, are expected to engage professionally and respectfully.

#### Standards

- Be direct and technical; criticism of code, design, or ideas is welcome.
- Personal attacks, harassment, and discriminatory conduct are not.
- Assume good faith; clarify before escalating.
- Confidential information (customer data, internal credentials, unpublished security findings) does not belong in public issues or PRs.

#### Enforcement

Report violations to **conduct@saluca.com**. Maintainers will review and respond privately. Outcomes may include private correction, temporary or permanent removal from the project, or referral to legal counsel for harassment that crosses statutory lines.

#### Scope

This code applies in all project spaces, including repos, issue trackers, pull requests, discussions, chat channels, and in-person events where Saluca LLC is represented.

## profile/README.md

### Saluca LLC

Sovereign AI infrastructure. Cryptographically-verified agent memory, post-quantum ready, deployable on-prem.

##### Products
- **Tiresias**, MSSP platform for always-on AI agent governance.
- **Mission Control** (**Saluca Micro-Lab** externally), headless COO appliance bundling persistent agent runtime with soul-svc, MCP, Tiresias, and Asphodel.
- **Asphodel**, quantum-resistant agent memory database.

##### Licensing
Most Saluca products dual-license: **PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0** for research and personal use, with a commercial SKU via Stripe. See individual repos.

##### Contact
cristian@saluca.com

## AGENTS.md

### AGENTS.md

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this repository.

#### What this is

The default community health files (security policy, contributing guide, code of conduct, issue and PR
templates) and the organization profile for every salucallc repo that has no file of its own. No code.

#### Read in this order

1. `README.md`: the Usage table lists every file and what GitHub uses it as.
2. The file you are changing.
3. `profile/README.md` only if the change is to the organization page.

#### What you can and cannot see

- You can see the defaults. You cannot see which repos override them from here. To check what one
  repo actually shows, run `gh api repos/salucallc/<repo>/community/profile`: a file URL under
  `salucallc/.github` means that repo inherits it from here.
- saluca-labs repos do not inherit anything from this repo.

#### Setup

Nothing to install. The repo is Markdown files that GitHub reads as defaults for every salucallc repo.

#### Test

There is no test suite. Before a PR, check that every link in README.md and llms.txt resolves and that
`llms-full.txt` matches the docs.

#### Conventions

- Every file here is shown in every salucallc repo that lacks its own copy. Keep the text general:
  no repo-specific instructions, internal tool names, hostnames, internal paths or personal addresses.
- Contact addresses are role addresses (`security@saluca.com`, `conduct@saluca.com`).
- When any doc changes, regenerate `llms-full.txt` in the same PR: the `llms.txt` header, then each file
  under a `## <path>` heading in the order README.md, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md,
  .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md,
  .github/pull_request_template.md, profile/README.md, AGENTS.md.
- No em-dashes.

#### Do not

- Describe files that do not exist here (CODEOWNERS and workflows are not inherited from this repo).
- Make this repo private: GitHub only applies defaults from a public `.github` repo.
- Commit secrets, hostnames, internal paths or personal emails.

#### Done means

Links resolve, README.md describes exactly the files present, and `llms-full.txt` is regenerated.
